finding: traceAttempt() selects its node with node.label.includes(attemptId) combined with node.label.startsWith("ATTEMPT_CREATED"). A label is display data, never identity, so a label merely CONTAINING the attempt id can be selected.
impactScope: traceAttempt is a T0 PUBLIC helper. It is NOT used by the V0/V0S/H0 Attempt-scoped consumer path: the composition adapter resolves the attempt from canonical event identity (event.entity_id === attemptId) and builds its own relation context. So the ordinary Handoff Preview is NOT affected by this matcher.
whyNotCorrectedInH1: an exact-identity fix requires new T0 domain structure (a canonical identity field on the node or a resolver over the Work events) and would touch T0 frozen projection semantics and historical digests. The ruling says to defer it to an independently reviewable T0 correctness slice.
deferredTo: a separate forward-only T0 correctness slice
verdict: DEFERRED — recorded with its precise impact, not corrected in H1
correctionAttempted: an exact-label fix was drafted and REVERTED before commit, so src/trajectory/projection.ts is byte-identical to the baseline (verified by git diff)
